Thailand: Nakornthon  Hospital received a Certificate of Recognition for Stroke Center Quality Accreditation from the Ministry of Public 
Health.
Period: 1 August 2025
Nakornthon  Hospital  received  the 5-Star  Standard  Stroke  Center  Certification  (SSCC)  for 2025  from  the Ministry  of Public  Health,  
the highest  level  of accreditation . The  hospital  was  also  awarded  the WSO  Angels  Awards  2024  – Platinum  Level  and  the Thailand  
Angels  Awards  2024  – Stroke  Ready  Level  by the Department  of Medical  Services . These  honors  reflect  the hospital’s  excellence  in 
providing  comprehensive  stroke  care,  from  the Stroke  Fast  Track  system  to rehabilitation  during  the Golden  Period .

Period: 2 July 2025
Nakornthon  Hospital  received  the Thailand  Moral  Awards  2024  in the Community  and  Organization  category  from  the Moral  Promotion  
Center  (Public  Organization) . The  award  honors  organizations  that  promote  moral  values  and  the Social  Credit  System,  serving  as 
role  models  for ethics  and  integrity . It was  presented  by Air Chief  Marshal  Chalit  Pukbhasuk , Privy  Councillor , on 2 July  2025 , at the 
National  Gallery,  Ministry  of Culture,  as part  of a national  initiative  to recognize  outstanding  organizations  across  all sectors  of Thai  
society .
